tagData.title: sliders
tagData.name: Sliders
tagData.description: Sliders are an important design element for websites. They help us to give the user a quick overview of what is on offer. A slider or scroller is typically a horizontal slider or scroller, typically found on the top of a website. It is usually used to showcase images, videos, and other content.
